mentions.name: MyLawnGuide
mentions.description: This app organizes and plans seasonal yard maintenance: enter your zip code, the type of grass you want, and where you're starting, and it generates a rough plan to follow for seeding, feeding, and pre-emergent treatment.
mentions.audience: Explicitly built for the author's own use, to help organize and plan their yard maintenance for the season.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building MyLawnGuide (https://mylawnguide.com) as a way to help me organize and plan my yard maintenance for the season.

Enter your zip, type of grass you want, where you're starting and it gives you a rough plan to follow for seeding, feeding, and pre-emergent.
